item.content:encoded: I would say it brings "Uzumaki" to mind most immediately for me, with its body horror, obsession, and deeper psychological/philosophical themes tying it all together. I think it would be a little reductive to both this work and that one to directly compare them, but you get what I mean. "Uzumaki" is a great, queasy read too (even if there's a lot of filler), check it out!
